brief:
A new documentary presents testimonies from international physicians who witnessed the breakdown of Gaza's healthcare system, Al Jazeera English reported. The film captures footage from foreign medical professionals describing conditions in the besieged territory.

The doctors' accounts focus on the collapse of Gaza's medical infrastructure during the ongoing conflict. Their testimonies provide eyewitness documentation of the humanitarian impact on the territory's healthcare capacity.
dek: A documentary shows footage from international doctors who bore witness to the collapse of the Gaza's medical system.
title: Documentary features international doctors' Gaza medical crisis testimony
